artifact: GRENDEL BC4 dark-scalar sensitivity (canonical published curve)
producer_git_note: Publish commit on llpatcolliders bc4-scalar: the Lambda_b production and uncertainty-band event-count-fix code together with the promoted central and 109-variation bundle CSVs. Supersedes the pre-Lambda_b producer sha 8c6fa509; grendel_scalar mirrors this tree.
source_run: Lambda_b republication 2026-07-18: central island from an 86-point, 400000-parent high-pT importance-sampled FONLL pool per b-hadron species (B+, B0, Bs, Lambda_b; tilt 5 GeV, 50% nominal mixture, seed 42, 100 decay/reconstruction samples); the uncertainty bundle is a matching 109-variation + 2 numerical-control campaign at 100000 parents per species.
generated_from: scalar.run_sensitivity (central) + scalar.uncertainty_band run/collect (bundle), both with the Lambda_b b-baryon pool and the physical Lambda recoil
correction: Adds the b-baryon pool (Lambda_b, FRAG 0.18755, physical Lambda recoil) to b -> X_s S; supersedes the 2026-07-15 meson-only curve AND its bundle. The lower edge strengthens by 8-18% (deepest reach 7.399e-12 -> 6.519e-12 at 0.975 GeV, -0.055 dex; growing toward closure), the closure extends 3.70 -> 3.80 GeV (interpolated 3.825), and one sensitive grid point is added (76 -> 77). Central and 109-variation bundle are regenerated together and are hash-linked.

hypothesis.model: PBC BC4: Higgs-portal dark scalar, mixing only (no quartic)

physics_inputs.production: inclusive b -> X_s S (Winkler arXiv:1809.01876 eq. A7) summed over B+, B0, Bs, and Lambda_b (b-baryon pool, spectator-independent rate); FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO); two-body recoil = kaon for the mesons, Lambda for Lambda_b
physics_inputs.decays: Winkler dispersive hadronic widths (digitized Fig. 4) below 2 GeV, perturbative spectator model above; analytic leptonic widths

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reconstruction and PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E)

column_contract.u2_min: lower sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island
column_contract.u2_max: upper sin^2 theta edge of the excluded island; NaN when u2_max_open is true
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3)
column_contract.peak_N: signal yield at the optimal mixing
column_contract.ctau_sin2th1_m: scalar ctau at sin^2 theta = 1, metres
column_contract.event_ess_columns: importance-weight effective event counts at the lower edge, peak, and upper edge

topology.finite_threshold_tips: Every adjacent finite sensitive/insensitive transition is closed by log-yield/log-coupling interpolation at N_signal = 3.

numerical_validation.interpretation: These six-million-event controls are the MESON-ONLY baseline: they retain sensitivity at 3.75 GeV, independently reject 3.80 and 3.85 GeV, and their interpolated closure (3.792 GeV) matches the meson-only central closure (3.798 GeV) within 0.006 GeV -- so the meson-only high-mass endpoint is not a finite-pool artifact. The published Lambda_b central closure is 3.825 GeV; its finite-pool robustness rests on the >= 2049 effective events at every sensitive peak (not on these meson-only controls), and a matching Lambda_b 6M control is a pending refresh (see lambda_b_note).
numerical_validation.lambda_b_note: The six-million-event controls below are the MESON-ONLY baseline; the Lambda_b central retains sensitivity at 3.80 GeV. A Lambda_b 6M control is a pending refresh (does not affect the published central or bundle).

closure_note: With the Lambda_b pool the inclusive b -> X_s S yield retains N_signal >= 3 at 3.80 GeV (peak_N = 3.44); log-yield interpolation between the 3.80 and 3.90 GeV central grid rows places the closure at 3.825 GeV (up from 3.7975 GeV meson-only). The deepest point remains at the f0(980) enhancement.

lambda_b_residuals.note: Central + 109-variation bundle are Lambda_b-consistent and hash-linked.
lambda_b_residuals.six_million_event_closure_control: numerical_validation.six_million_event_high_mass_peak_controls is still the MESON-ONLY baseline (placed closure at 3.79 GeV). The Lambda_b central retains sensitivity at 3.80 GeV; a Lambda_b 6M control is a small pending refresh, not required for the band.
